subject: Invoice #1234 overdue
body: Dear customer, our records show that invoice #1234 for 2,450 EUR was due on 1 November and remains unpaid. Please arrange payment within 7 days to avoid a late fee. If you have already paid, kindly send us the remittance details.

subject: Weekly engineering sync
body: Agenda: review of last sprint, the database migration plan for Q1, and the API latency incident from Tuesday. Please add your topics to the doc before Thursday 10:00. The release checklist will be finalised at the end of the meeting.

subject: Company retreat announcement
body: We invite you to our annual company retreat in Bergen on 12-14 June! Colleagues from all offices will join for workshops, team-building activities and a celebration dinner. Our marketing team will share photos from the event on our social media channels, so please let HR know if you prefer not to appear.

subject: Can't log in to my account
body: Hello, since this morning I am unable to log in. I tried to reset my password twice but never received the reset email. Could you help me as soon as possible? Ticket number would be appreciated.

subject: Updated NDA for review
body: Hi Anna, please find attached the updated NDA. Our legal team changed the liability clause and added a GDPR data-processing section. Could you review the agreement and return it signed by Friday?

subject: Proposal and pricing for 50 licences
body: Good afternoon, as discussed during the demo, here is our proposal for 50 licences with a 15% volume discount. The quote is valid until the end of the month. Let me know if you'd like to proceed with the purchase.

subject: Q4 newsletter campaign
body: Hi team, the Q4 newsletter campaign goes out next Tuesday. Please send me product launch highlights and customer quotes by Friday so we can finalise the copy and brand visuals.

subject: Welcome aboard!
body: Hi Jonas, welcome to the team! Your onboarding starts Monday at 9:00 with an introduction to our benefits and vacation policy. Please bring an ID for payroll registration.

subject: Lunch on Friday?
body: Hey, are you free for lunch on Friday? There's a new ramen place near the office I'd love to try.
